title: Micro-crack detection of multicrystalline solar cells featuring an improved anisotropic diffusion filter and image segmentation technique
venue: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing
mechanism: Improved anisotropic diffusion smooths grain boundaries and dislocation texture while keeping crack edges in multicrystalline EL; then segmentation.
evidence: R: classical micro-crack detection on multicrystalline EL cells (no deep baseline).
adaptation: Compute offline per cell and add the AD residual as channel 2, mainly for sp_multi cells. Also the classical non-learned baseline for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: house + AD residual channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: test crack IoU on multi cells, relF1@2. Kill: < +0.012 crack IoU.

alt_notes.adaptation: Offline AD-filtered residual as input channel 2, mainly for sp_multi cells; also the classical baseline in the benchmark.
